groups.title: Core Web Vitals
groups.question: Your Astro blog's hero image loads slowly and text jumps around as images load. Explain the two metrics affected and how you would fix them.

followUps.Largest Contentful Paint (LCP): What affects Largest Contentful Paint and how do you improve it?
followUps.Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS): What causes layout shift and how do you prevent it?

evidence.text: LCP measures when the largest visible element finishes rendering.
Large unoptimised hero images and slow servers delay it.
Optimised, correctly sized images loaded with priority improve it.

notEnough: Only saying LCP is load speed.

evidence.text: CLS measures unexpected layout movement.
Images without dimensions and late-inserted content cause shifts.
Setting width and height or reserving space prevents them.

notEnough: Only saying CLS is layout shift.

groups.title: Lighthouse Auditing
groups.question: Performance keeps slipping with each release and nobody notices. Explain how you would audit automatically and set limits.

followUps.Running Lighthouse in CI: How does Lighthouse CI catch regressions?

evidence.text: Lighthouse CI runs audits in the deployment pipeline.
Builds fail when scores drop below set thresholds.
It covers performance, accessibility and SEO.
A budget sets maximum sizes and timings, like JavaScript size or time to interactive.
Tools enforce it automatically.
It stops slow growth that nobody notices release by release.

groups.title: SEO Fundamentals
groups.question: Your Astro pages rarely show up in search results and shared links have no preview. Explain meta tags and sitemaps.

followUps.Meta Tags and Open Graph: What do meta description and Open Graph tags do?
followUps.Sitemap Generation: How does a sitemap help, and how do you generate one in Astro?

evidence.text: The meta description summarises the page for search results.
Open Graph tags control link previews on social sites.
Each page needs its own accurate tags.
A sitemap lists the site's public URLs.
It helps search engines find all pages.
The sitemap integration generates it automatically at build time.

groups.title: Asset Optimization
groups.question: Text is invisible for a moment while fonts load, and the first paint waits on a large stylesheet. Explain how you would load fonts and CSS.

followUps.Critical CSS and Resource Hints: How do critical CSS and resource hints speed up the first paint?

evidence.text: Without it, text can be hidden while the web font downloads.
swap shows a fallback font immediately and switches when the font loads.
Preloading key fonts makes them arrive sooner.
Critical CSS inlines the styles needed for the first screen.
This avoids waiting for a full stylesheet before painting.
Resource hints like preload and preconnect start important downloads early.
